reserveReview.rationale: The issuer live backing API read on 2026-09-21 reports 34,939.61267289634 USDU-equivalent in Morpho and 22,684.148785465073 in Curve, with 5.1206765e-10 in TermMax, totaling 57,623.76145836193. Ethereum block 26024768 (0x18d1b40, hash 0x3ecb59e5896b8506b3a32d29e5cbaaf201a45aa4ec315628ca02d283b9980766, timestamp 2026-09-21T08:42:35Z) identifies Curve coins(0) as USDC and coins(1) as USDU; balances(0) and balances(1) return 30,864.253806 USDC and 19,232.031274025132 USDU. Splitting the API-valued Curve position by those constituent balances and normalizing total backing yields 60.6340% Morpho self-exposure, 15.1126% Curve USDU self-exposure, and 24.2534% external USDC collateral after rounding the residual. The issuer API does not expose its own block number; these are same-day observations rather than a claimed atomic reconciliation. No circulating-supply value is overridden.
